1.Dr D Srinivasulu Reddy & Dr K Lokesh Krishna received a grant of 2.62 Lakhs  from ATAL-
AICTE to organize an international Conference ICETECCI-2022 under department of ECE. 
2. Dr C Chandrasekhar received SERB grant of ONE lakh Fifty Thousand rupees for 
organizing “AR and VR workshop” under department of ECE. 
3. Dr P Selvaraj  Received MODROBS fund of 8.96 lakhs for Power electronics lab 
modernization under department of EEE. 
4. Received funding of ONE lakh under the Scheme for Promoting Interest, Creativity and 
Ethics among Students (SPICES) for the Financial Year 2022-23 under department of English. 
5. Dr P Babu Reddy received funding of ONE lakh for organizing national symposium on 
“Nano structured materials for Battery & Super Capacitors” under department of Physics. 
6. Dr. Jagath Narayana & Dr N Rajesh received SERB grant o f ONE lakh rupees for 
organizing workshop on "Recent Advances in Additive Manufacturing for Mechanical and 
Aerospace Engineering" under department of Mechanical. 
7. Mr SkAllabaksh  received fund of 250 dollars from IEEE SPS society to organize 
motivation sessions under department of ECE 
8. Under PMKVY 4.0 we organized and completed certified technical training on different 
job roles for 250 students of different branches. For this w e received central government fund 
around 30 Lakhs.
